name: ops-conventions
description: Operator working conventions for ZCode: delivery-first output style, placeholder convention for reusable commands, and a collaborator agent profile. Contains no binaries and makes no network calls.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向 ZCode 的操作者工作约定：交付优先的输出风格、便于复用的占位符约定，以及一个协作者 agent profile。无二进制、无网络调用。
